children: Everpure, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $1.19B and diluted EPS of $0.21, reflecting strong top-line growth and higher profitability versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “income per share attributable to common stockholders, diluted”.
Revenue growth was broad-based: product revenue rose 54% while subscription revenue increased 20% year over year.
Channel and product mix shifted toward larger, higher-margin enterprise configurations and hyperscaler royalty arrangements.
Subscription ARR grew 20% year over year, with Evergreen and consumption offerings expanding recurring revenue and remaining performance obligations to $4.1B.
Operational scaling included capital investment and strategic component purchases to support Evergreen/One, hyperscaler deployments, data center expansion and the 1touch acquisition.
